description.value: View Spec Sheet Professional Mid-Bass Driver for Sound Reinforcement Systems The FS10.20A8 is a high-efficiency 10" ceramic woofer engineered for professional sound reinforcement applications requiring controlled mid-bass response, high power handling, and consistent manufacturing performance. Designed by B&C Group and produced to Eminence Pro(TM) standards, this driver is optimized for OEM loudspeaker systems in portable PA, stage monitor, and fixed installation markets. Rated at 250 W AES / 500 W program, the FS10.20A8 is designed for sustained operation in high-output environments. Its 94.7 dB sensitivity supports efficient system designs with strong acoustic output and predictable amplifier loading. The driver operates over a 60 Hz - 4 kHz frequency range, making it suitable for mid-bass and low-mid applications where vocal clarity and transient control are critical. The motor structure features a 51 mm (2") ISV(TM) interleaved sandwich voice coil for improved thermal stability and reduced power compression. A curvilinear, water-repellent treated paper cone provides controlled response, mechanical stability, and environmental durability across a wide range of operating conditions. With recommended enclosure volumes of 35 - 80 liters, the FS10.20A8 integrates easily into new cabinet designs or platform updates, offering consistent Thiele-Small parameters and repeatable performance for scalable production. OEM Design Advantages 250 W AES / 500 W Program Power Handling 94.7 dB Sensitivity (2.83 V / 1 m) Controlled Response from 60 Hz - 4 kHz 2" ISV(TM) Voice Coil for Thermal and Mechanical Reliability Treated Paper Cone for Environmental Resistance Optimized for Compact PA and Monitor Enclosures
